text:
Sam: Heads-up  partners asked for a coordinated regional rollout for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Idea: stagger marketplace listings + press windows to avoid capacity spikes. Thoughts?

Tina: +1. Need hard gates: lab cert done, driver/firmware freeze, SKU tagging. SIs want a 10-day early test window. Can we commit?

Marco: Ops: we can do stagger NA -> EU -> APAC. But H200 microcode still has an open ticket. Recommend a fallback mapping to quantized variants to avoid hard failures.

Liu: From SI side: we need sample AMIs/images, kernel tags, and a minimal test harness. Will provide a CI matrix if we lock kernels today.

Helen: Comms: please stop a global press blast. Suggest rolling press: NA, then EU a week later, APAC the week after. Need embargo text by Friday to hold NA slot. @Sam can you own?

Sam: I can own embargo draft and loop legal. Draft staging plan below.

```
staging_draft:
Day 0: SI enablement + partner images (internal preview)
Day 3: NA marketplace preview (limited SKUs)
Day 10: EU GA for core SKUs; MI300 limited beta
Day 17: APAC GA all SKUs + final press window
Press cadence: NA -> EU(+7d) -> APAC(+14d)
Fallbacks: region routing -> quantized variant -> limited burst pools
```

Tina: Agree. Also can we standardize SKU names? Last time `redwood-h100` vs `h100-standard` broke onboarding.

Marco: Runtime action: add `h200 -> h200-lowmem` fallback and validate routing in staging by Tue. I'll take it.

Liu: I'll publish images to s3://partners/staging/ and share creds with SIs today. CI matrix to follow.

Helen: DeployBot, can you post daily status to #partnerships during the rollout week?

DeployBot: Daily status scheduled 2024-05-04 through 2024-05-12 to #partnerships.

Sam: If everyone can hit dates I'll lock the draft and schedule a 30m sync with legal+press tomorrow. Please add marketplace PRs to the `marketplace-changes` board so comms can track.

Tina: Confirmed.

Marco: Confirmed.

Liu: Confirmed.

Helen: Confirmed.
